definitions.gloss: sacred fire; Olympic flame; Olympic torch
definitions.explanation: A fire used in ceremonies or rituals, most commonly referring to the Olympic flame that is lit in Olympia, Greece and carried by torch relay to the host city.

examples.japanese: {聖火|せいか}が{灯|とも}された。
{聖火|せいか}リレーが{今日|きょう}から{始|はじ}まる。
{開会式|かいかいしき}で{最終|さいしゅう}{聖火|せいか}ランナーが{聖火|せいか}{台|だい}に{火|ひ}を{灯|とも}す{瞬間|しゅんかん}は{感動的|かんどうてき}だった。
examples.english: The moment the final torchbearer lit the Olympic cauldron at the opening ceremony was deeply moving.

notes:
USAGE:
{聖火|せいか} is most commonly associated with the Olympic Games. The {聖火|せいか}リレー (torch relay) is a major public event in the host country. {聖火|せいか}{台|だい} refers to the Olympic cauldron where the flame burns throughout the games.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聖火|せいか}リレー (torch relay)
- {聖火|せいか}{台|だい} (Olympic cauldron)
- {聖火|せいか}ランナー (torchbearer)
- {聖火|せいか}を{灯|とも}す (to light the Olympic flame)
